title: Magnitude and Direction of a Net Force
body: Two horses pull a sledge on flat terrain. The net force is $$\vec{F}=-(2980.0\,\text{N})\hat{i}+(8200.0\,\text{N})\hat{j}$$, $$where$$ $$i$$ $$points$$ $$east$$ $$and$$ $$j$$ $$points$$ $$north$$. $$Find$$ $$the$$ $$magnitude$$ $$and$$ $$direction$$ $$of$$ $$this$$ $$force$$.
